name: aloe barbadensis leaf + centella asiatica leaf
purpose: 1. Helps restore the health of damaged nails, enhances the hardness of nails, reduces breakage and peeling, and makes nails stronger. 2. Help eliminate the discomfort and appearance problems caused by fungal infection of toenails and restore the healthy appearance of toenails. 3. It can provide nutrients to nails, thereby promoting the repair function of nails and gradually restoring the smoothness and luster of nails.
uses: 1. Trim the affected toenail with a stainless steel nail file, clean and keep dry 2. Apply an appropriate amount of this product evenly to the entire nail surface 3. Wait for it to dry and allow it to be absorbed.
otcwarn: Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
